content: Chroma v2 (github.com/alecthomas/chroma/v2, v2.27.0 as of Jun 17 2026) is the recommended Go syntax highlighter. It is a pure-Go port of Pygments by the same author (Alec Thomas), with the same language database (200+ languages). Three-component architecture: Lexers (tokenize source), Formatters (render output), Styles (map tokens to colors). Terminal formatters: 8-color, 256-color, true-color ANSI. Supports quick.Highlight() for fast use. AdaptiveColor and ANSI2RGB mapping built-in. Used by Hugo. v3 exists as v3.0.0-alpha.1 but is not stable — replaces Iterator with iter.Seq[Token] (requires Go 1.23). Use v2 for production.
